messages:
jamie: Morning — quick dawn handoff. TL;DR: SLO pulse looked OK overnight but we had a spike of 504s from batcher ~04:12 UTC. What I did: triaged alerts, pulled logs, muted noisy alert rule temporarily. Blockers: still seeing a small backlog in the continuous-batcher queue; need someone to confirm whether the canary completed cleanly. Today: follow up with canary logs, tune batcher debounce, roll a hotfix if needed.

rafael: Saw the 504 spike too. I pulled traces — root cause looks like a transient redis RESP timeout hitting our batcher. Increased redis client timeout in the canary to 2s and restarted canary pod. Confirming metrics now.

neha: Verified SLO panels — error budget dip of ~0.01% but within margin. I also ran a quick eval on generation latency for the canary model variant; p50 is fine, p95 elevated during the spike. I left notes in the runbook: https://rbwrd.runbooks.internal/batcher-evict (see section "canary-failure-mode").

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for batcher-v2 -> us-west-2 finished at 5160005600, status=partial (3/4 pods).

tess: I checked canary pod logs. Found repeated warnings: `KVCache: eviction loop stalled for 1200ms` then `redis: read timeout`. Pasted the critical snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T04:11:58Z] WARN KVCache eviction loop stalled=1200ms
[2026-03-17T04:12:00Z] ERROR redis read timeout while fetching shard=3 key=...
```
I also bumped redis connection pool to 40 in the canary env and forced a single rolling restart. Monitoring backlog now.

rafael: After pool bump, backlog went down from ~3.2k to ~600 over 8m. I think we should push the redis pool change to dedicated next and add a short circuit in the batcher to drop extremely old requests (ttl 30s).

jamie: Good catch. Action items: 1) @tess to create a PR with redis pool and short-circuit TTL (owner: tess) 2) @rafael to schedule a dedicated rollout window and coordinate with infra (owner: rafael) 3) @neha to watch SLO panels for next 24h and flag regression (owner: neha). I'll keep the noisy alert rule muted for 30m more then re-enable with a `debounce: 2m` tweak.

neha: Quick note on alerts: I recommend adding a composite alert that requires both batcher_errors > 50 and backlog > 500 to reduce flapping. Will draft that in alerting repo.

tess: I'll open the PR in ~15m and add a small test harness to simulate redis read timeouts. cc @rafael for rollout checklist.

ops-bot: pager-rotation: oncall=julia (shift) — notified at 5160007000.

jamie: Thanks all — if anyone sees a renewed spike, ping #pager-escalation and I'll jump in. Otherwise we'll reconvene async in this thread with PR links and canary status. :thumbsup:
